subject.title: fix(telegram): keep over-limit-name models selectable in /model picker (#98221)

question: After the sort-order bug is repaired, should maintainers make this PR the canonical fix for the linked Telegram over-limit `/model` callback issue, or choose the open sibling implementation instead?
rationale: Both open candidates address the same model-picker bug with different callback contracts, and the provider/model routing behavior should be intentional before merge.

options.title: Repair and use this PR
options.body: Fix the shared ordering issue and use this minimal fallback because it preserves existing name-based callbacks except when Telegram’s limit requires `mdl_idx_*`.

options.title: Choose the sibling candidate
options.body: Select https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98694 as canonical if maintainers prefer that broader indexed callback format after review.

options.title: Pause both candidates
options.body: Keep both open until a Telegram owner explicitly selects the permanent callback format, accepting the additional review delay.

recommendation.title: Repair and use this PR
recommendation.body: Fix the shared ordering issue and use this minimal fallback because it preserves existing name-based callbacks except when Telegram’s limit requires `mdl_idx_*`.

likelyOwner.reason: The byte-limit refactor and nearby Telegram callback history make this the best available owner for the callback-format and merge-risk choice.
